note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list. Guides are written in our own words from the cited sources; where no source has pinned a trigger down yet, the guide says so instead of guessing.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is nothing to do directly: work the roadmap in order and this one closes the list. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 in difficulty and puts the platinum at about 200 hours, with one playthrough enough and no online trophies anywhere on the list.
steps: Play through the story and clear the side strands in stages 1 to 6.
After the credits, work the 100% Completion checklist in stage 7.
Mop up any remaining activity, collectible and combat trophies.
The platinum unlocks automatically once trophy 54 of 54 is in.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy from the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is one of the first missions of Chapter 1 and cannot be missed: just play the story from the start and it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening sequence.
Follow the on-screen prompts through Gone Fishing.
Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, do the one thing that might not come back: Lucia's meditation on the balcony at Jason's house, the first spot for Positive Mental Attitude. The chapter trophy itself cannot be missed.
steps: Play every Chapter 1 story mission to the chapter's end.
Before the chapter closes, meditate on the balcony at Jason's house.
Finish the last Chapter 1 mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. This is where Leonida opens up: from the mission Coffee Break onward you can free-roam with both protagonists, switch between them and call your partner to join you, so use the chapter to start scanning vehicles and studying animals for the late game.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 story missions through to the end.
Once free roam opens, scan vehicles and study animals as you travel.
Finish the final Chapter 2 mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. The Cartel Heist mission in this chapter also carries its own trophy, Break the Bank, so the chapter is worth playing carefully rather than rushing past its set pieces.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 story missions in order.
Complete The Cartel Heist when it appears.
Finish the last Chapter 3 mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Several story trophies land in this chapter, including Family Matters, DWNFALL and Hi-Jacked, and an optional mission here opens the bank vaults, so take the optional missions as they appear.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 story missions through.
Take optional missions when offered, especially the one that opens bank vaults.
Finish the final Chapter 4 mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for finishing the final mission. After the credits you keep free roam of Leonida, the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress, and nothing on it is missable, so the real trophy work starts here rather than ending.
steps: Complete the story through the final mission.
After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion.
Use that checklist as the stage 7 work list.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks by playing the story and cannot be missed.
steps: Play through Chapter 2 until Breakfast Run appears.
Complete the mission.
The trophy unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission. It unlocks by playing the story and cannot be missed.
steps: Play through Chapter 3 until The Cartel Heist appears.
Complete the heist mission.
The trophy unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. It unlocks by playing the story and cannot be missed.
steps: Play through Chapter 4 until Child's Play appears.
Complete the mission.
The trophy unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. It unlocks by playing the story and cannot be missed.
steps: Play through Chapter 4 until Headliners appears.
Complete the mission.
The trophy unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks by playing the story and cannot be missed.
steps: Play through Chapter 4 until VCIA Takedown appears.
Complete the mission.
The trophy unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks by playing the story and cannot be missed.
steps: Play through Chapter 5 until Operation Savage Glory appears.
Complete the mission.
The trophy unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list and the real platinum gate. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, but everything you did before already counts and nothing on it is missable. It is lenient: it asks for a share of most things, not all of them, but a few lines demand everything, including all robberies, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, every shooting-range gold and every drone race.
steps: Finish the story first so the checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion.
Clear the lines that demand everything: robberies, bank vaults, gang operations, shooting ranges, drone races, Bret's Target Decks.
Fill the shared lines to their thresholds: 100 optional tasks, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals.
Hit 100% and the gold unlocks, usually leaving only a few clean-up trophies.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida, in any mix of the four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the fastest way to rack them up, and the optional challenge shown on each stunt is not needed. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.
steps: Open the map and show Stunt Spots, or check Progress, then Activities, then Stunts.
Fly under bridges in a plane or helicopter for the quickest count.
Mix in stunt jumps off ramps and construction sites when you pass them.
Reach 250 for the trophy, then 300 for 100% Completion.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. You do not need to win or finish anything, just sample each one: a race, a shooting range, a drone race, fishing, an arcade game, pool, mini golf, basketball and bowling are the kinds of things that count. The in-game Progress menu shows which activity types you have tried.
steps: Open Progress and look at the Activities list to see what you have tried.
Play one round of each activity type you have not touched yet.
Winning is not required: starting and playing each type once is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The ranges include Rodgers Ranch and Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Gold needs speed and accuracy together, so learn each challenge's target order first with a slow run, then push for time. Track progress under Progress, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges.
steps: Visit a shooting range and open its challenge list.
Run each challenge once slowly to learn the target order.
Replay for gold: fast, accurate shots, no wasted reloads.
Gold all 42 challenges across the ranges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total and 100% Completion wants all of them, but this trophy only needs one win per location. Learn each course's corners before racing flat out: a clean line beats a fast crash.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone location on the map.
Fly the course once to learn its gates and turns.
Race again and win at that location.
Repeat until you have a win at all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer. Winning the same race twice does not count, so work through the list and tick off new ones. The 100% checklist wants 30 of the 40 won, so keep going after this trophy pops.
steps: Open the map and look at Activities, then Racing, for the race list.
Pick a race you have not won yet and win it.
Move on to a different race each time.
Win 20 different races for the trophy, 30 for 100%.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. He texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the spot with a purple icon, so answer the text and head to the marker. Fishing is about timing your reel and keeping the line tension steady rather than mashing the button.
steps: Play through Chapter 1 until Cal texts you about fishing.
Follow the purple icon to the fishing spot.
Win the fishing challenge against Cal.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida, start a game and play it through to its end. Any arcade game counts, so pick the one you find easiest and finish it.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in a bar or arcade venue.
Start any arcade game.
Play it through to completion.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand by playing his final mission. Andy is one of the side characters whose jobs run alongside the story; his strand stays open after the story, but the guides warn that some stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so do not leave his missions until the very end.
steps: Take Andy's missions whenever they appear.
Work through his strand in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand by playing his final mission. Take his jobs as they appear during the story rather than leaving the whole strand for after the credits.
steps: Take Kenton's missions whenever they appear.
Work through his strand in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand by playing his final mission. His five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission, and they stay open after the story, so this is a safe strand to finish in stage 6.
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission that opens it, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Play Billy's five jobs in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying stranger mission strands. Not every stranger counts: the strands that count include Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not count toward the 8, even though they have their own trophies. Work the counting strands first and check your progress as you go.
steps: Find stranger missions marked on the map as you explore.
Prioritise the counting strands: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, plus other qualifying strangers.
Finish each strand to its last mission.
Complete 8 qualifying strands for the silver.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand by playing his final mission. Take his jobs as they appear during the story rather than leaving the whole strand for after the credits.
steps: Take Randy's missions whenever they appear.
Work through his strand in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand by playing his final mission. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, but it has its own trophy, so finish it in stage 6 alongside the other side characters.
steps: Take Tyrone's missions whenever they appear.
Work through his strand in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. This is the only trophy any guide flags as possibly missable. The first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, and it is reported to disappear after that chapter, so do it before Chapter 1 ends even though nobody has confirmed it is required. The last meditation needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. Note the 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so this trophy needs three more than the checklist does.
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate on the balcony at Jason's house before the chapter ends.
After Chapter 2, meditate at each new spot as you find it.
Work through all 10 locations until all 18 spots are done.
The trophy pops on the 18th meditation.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His hunting quests start after Chapter 2 and are Jason-only. The exact animal is not confirmed by the guides yet, so follow Bret's quest marker and hunt the animal the quest names; do not guess at a target from an unconfirmed list.
steps: After Chapter 2, take Bret's hunting quests as Jason.
Follow the quest marker to the hunting area.
Track and take down the unique animal the quest names.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of the 18 in the game. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so pick up every card you pass while doing other things and check your collection after each new area to see which sets are nearly complete. The 100% checklist wants all 15 of Bret's Target Decks, which is a separate, larger ask.
steps: Pick up collectible cards wherever you find them in the world.
Check your collection to see which sets are nearly complete.
Finish 3 full sets for the trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations, in any mix of Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35), Sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags. The WAiNK phone app marks scannable spots as you explore, so open it whenever you reach a new area and clear its markers before moving on.
steps: Open the WAiNK app on your phone when you reach a new area.
Scan each marked Landmark, Curiosity, Sculpture or No Flusher tag.
Keep scanning as you travel until you reach 100 locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. There are eight categories of ten, all available from the start and listed under Progress, then Challenges. Leave this until late: by then you will have completed a lot without trying, then pick the quickest of what remains. The 100% checklist wants 70.
steps: Open Progress, then Challenges, and look at the eight categories.
Play normally and let challenges complete on their own.
Late in the game, pick off the quickest unfinished challenges.
Reach 50 for the trophy, then 70 for 100%.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. Call your partner to join you first, then build the heat up to four stars and break line of sight until the wanted level clears. Tunnels, the countryside and a fast car all help you disappear.
steps: Call your partner to join you.
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level between robberies. Pick three shops close together, keep your partner with you, and move fast from one to the next so the heat stays on but you never get caught or lose it entirely.
steps: Call your partner to join you and pick three nearby shops.
Rob the first shop and get a wanted level.
Move straight to the second and third shops and rob them too.
Keep the wanted level alive through all three robberies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them. Scan every new vehicle you pass, especially in traffic and car parks, and the count climbs fast. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning long after this trophy pops.
steps: Scan every vehicle you have not seen before.
Work through traffic, car parks and dealerships for new models.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles for the trophy.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill your Focus first, then trigger it in a fight with a crowd of enemies and use an assault rifle so each shot counts. Gang operations and robberies give you plenty of grouped targets.
steps: Fill your Combat Focus meter in fights.
Find a fight with at least 5 enemies grouped together.
Trigger Combat Focus with an assault rifle ready.
Take down 5 enemies before the Focus ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. Steal a passenger jet parked at a boarding gate, take off and get about a kilometre away. Expect police attention on the ground, so board quickly and climb fast once you are rolling.
steps: Go to VCIA and reach a passenger jet at a boarding gate.
Board the jet and start it up.
Take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. The Rhino is heavily armed and armoured, so once you are in the driver's seat, use its cannon on the soldiers that come after you.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station.
Steal a Rhino tank.
Take out enemies from inside the tank.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs give you the Snap Gun, which opens the back door quietly, so get the Snap Gun first and use the back entrance instead of smashing the front.
steps: Play Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs to get the Snap Gun.
Pick a jewelry store and enter through the back door.
Take the goods and leave without ever being spotted.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, out of the 8 in the game. Vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission and every vault job brings 4 stars, so have a fast bike ready for the getaway before you go in. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults.
steps: Play the optional Chapter 4 mission that opens bank vaults.
Hit a vault and grab the cash.
Escape on a fast bike with the police on you.
Rob 5 vaults for the trophy, all 8 for 100%.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida, so wait for one on a quiet stretch, stop it, crack it open and get away before the police box you in. A bank vault job also counts if you get away clean.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop the truck and rob it.
Escape the police.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida by clearing the fog from the whole map. Leonida holds 52 areas to reveal, and a plane is the fastest way: fly a grid over the state and watch the fog lift. Driving works too but takes far longer, so save the last corners for a flight.
steps: Get a plane and fly over unexplored parts of the map.
Watch the fog lift as you cover new ground.
Cover every corner of Leonida until the map is fully revealed.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang: one per gang, 9 gangs in total. Operations are marked as you explore, so hit one for every gang you come across. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations cleared, so keep robbing them after this trophy pops.
steps: Find an illegal operation on the map.
Rob it and escape.
Repeat for each of the 9 gangs until every gang has one robbed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger has not been pinned down by the guides yet, so the honest advice is to go to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. Check back here once players crack the exact steps.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find a bar with a view of the water.
Order a cocktail and enjoy the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description points to driving out through the showroom window, but the exact steps are still unconfirmed, so take a car inside a showroom and drive it out through the glass, then check whether the trophy pops.
steps: Get a car inside a vehicle showroom.
Drive it out through the showroom window.
Escape the scene.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The working route is to rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, then lose the police. It is a gang operation, so bring a plan for the getaway before you start.
steps: Go to the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn.
Rob the operation.
Lose the police to finish the job.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The route is to max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia, and working out together trains both at once, so hit the gym as a pair and build their Strength to the top.
steps: Go to a gym with both protagonists together.
Work out to raise Strength for both Jason and Lucia.
Max out Strength for both of them.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Ordinary crime and chaos move the profile, so this one builds up naturally over a long playthrough. One warning: do not push toward the Irredeemable profile, because it is permanent.
steps: Play normally and let your actions shape your Criminal Profile.
Keep making profile-changing choices across the game.
Reach 500 profile actions for the trophy.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed by the guides, so the honest advice is that it likely comes from succeeding at something on a second attempt. Try a failed activity again and finish it the second time around.
steps: Attempt an activity or challenge and fail it once.
Try the same thing again straight away.
Succeed on the second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The exact trigger is still unconfirmed by the guides, and it most likely comes from witnessing one of Leonida's strange encounters. Explore odd corners of the map, follow anything unusual you see, and this one should find you.
steps: Explore unusual places across Leonida.
Follow any strange event or encounter you come across.
Witness the event through to its end.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. The exact method is still unconfirmed by the guides, but the name says it: knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Try a slow drive-by with a melee weapon ready.
steps: Get in a vehicle with a melee weapon equipped.
Drive slowly past a pedestrian.
Strike them with the melee attack from the moving vehicle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. It is a running total, so every laundered bill adds up over time, and Yasmani pays the most per bill. Keep laundering through the story and side jobs and the total climbs on its own.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and jobs.
Launder them through your contacts, favouring Yasmani for the best rate.
Keep going until the running total reaches $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, as a running total. Weapons, ammo, clothes and vehicle upgrades all count, so buy what you need as you play and the total adds up. It pairs well with the money you earn from laundering Marked Bills.
steps: Buy weapons, ammo and gear as you play.
Spend on clothes and vehicle upgrades too.
Keep spending until the running total reaches $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: the 8 for sale, about $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count, so buy each of the 8 purchasable garages from their for-sale signs. Save up through the story and buy them as you can afford them.
steps: Save up around $160,000 through the story and side jobs.
Find each of the 8 garages for sale.
Buy all 8 garage properties.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which Moses gives you in Chapter 2. You need free garage space for each registration, so clear a slot before you register, then scan and register vehicles you find around Leonida.
steps: Get the Scooter Bros app from Moses in Chapter 2.
Make sure you have free garage space.
Register 10 different vehicles through the app.
